title: DatabaseManager单例按路径污染，测试/多pipeline互相污染

tests.issue: DatabaseManager.get_instance() returns first-created instance regardless of requested db_path
Direct DatabaseManager() creates separate instance but get_instance() still returns singleton

evidence.note: Direct instantiation can create different instance, but get_instance() ignores it

tests.issue: StateManager() called without db_path uses default 'docuswarm.db' via DatabaseManager.get_instance()

evidence.finding: update_context_sdk creates StateManager() WITHOUT db_path, so it uses DatabaseManager.get_instance() with default path

code: Line 65:     def get_instance(cls, db_path: Path | str = "docuswarm.db") -> DatabaseManager:
Line 66:         """Get or create the singleton DatabaseManager instance.
Line 69:             db_path: Path to the SQLite database file.
design_flaws: Single class-level _instance cannot hold multiple db_path instances
db_path parameter in get_instance() is only used on first call
No warning when requested db_path differs from stored instance's path
